text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of the "Summer 
Training Camp"— To conquer the remaining 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Arima Kinen, our 
fiery camp begins!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Trainer-kun! There are countless 
training regimens that can only be done in 
the summer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Time is limited! Devise an efficient 
training regimen!

Quite unlike last year, Agnes Tachyon 
seems fully in the mood to devote herself 
to training...!
